meta.title: The State of the American Dream
meta.subtitle: U.S. quality-of-life indicators over time, graded by year and presidential term
meta.note: Data from official U.S. statistical agencies via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis). 2026 is a partial year (year-to-date averages) and is excluded from the composite grade. Presidential terms are a time grouping (president in office mid-year), not a claim of causation. Shaded grey spans are NBER recessions.
